brandStory.description: Every candle is poured with intention, designed to turn ordinary moments into something memorable.

craft.label: Our Craft
craft.title: Thirty Years of Light & Scent
craft.p1: Every Solenne candle begins its journey with the finest natural soy wax, harvested sustainably. We believe that what you invite into your sanctuary matters deeply — which is why every raw material is chosen with uncompromising reverence for both purity and the living earth.
craft.p2: Our master chandlers hand-pour each creation in small, patient batches, infusing essences composed in Grasse, France. Over three decades, our formula has remained an art of patience: slow pours, meticulous temperature control, and a two-week curing ritual before any candle leaves our care.
craft.p3: Finished with hand-embossed labels and encased in recyclable vessels, each candle is a tactile poem — designed to transform your everyday dwelling into a tranquil retreat.

about.heroTitle: Thirty Years of Light, Quietude, and Scent
about.heroDescription: Solenne was founded upon a singular meditation: that a candle is far more than fragrance. It is a slow ceremony of peace, crafted with integrity from earth-given elements that honor the sanctuary of home.
about.craftP1: Every Solenne candle begins in our quiet atelier, where limited batches are hand-poured with unhurried precision. We work deliberately, knowing that true luxury cannot be accelerated.
about.craftP2: From wick placement to the final trim, each phase adheres to our ancestral ritual: controlled pouring temperatures, clean cotton braiding, and fourteen days of curing before a piece is deemed worthy of your mantelpiece.
about.ingredientsP1: We use 100% natural, American-grown soy wax, lead-free cotton wicks, and botanical fragrance essences composed in Grasse, France — formulated strictly without phthalates or petroleum byproducts.
about.ingredientsP2: Each aromatic creation unfurls in three harmonious movements: ephemeral top notes that greet you, rich heart accords that linger through the evening, and grounding base notes that perfume the room long after the flame rests.
about.sustainabilityP1: Our heavy glass vessels are designed to be treasured, then reimagined for a second life. Every jar, carton, and ribbon is sustainably sourced and fully recyclable.
about.sustainabilityP2: We offset transit emissions and maintain minimal, plastic-free presentation — because quiet refinement has nothing to conceal.
